blocks.arabic_text: شَيْءٍ خَلْقَهُ ثُمَّ هَدَي۞ قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ الْقُرُونِ اْلأُولي ۞ قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَابٍ ۚ لَا يَضِلُّ رَبِّي وَلَا يَنْسَي ۞ اَلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اْلأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلاً وَأَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (When the two of them came to Fir'awn and spoke) he asked, “O Musa, who is the Rabb of you two?” He said, “Our Rabb is the One who gave everything its form and then (also) showed (it) the right way.” He asked, “What is the state of the earlier generations?” He said, “The knowledge of it is with my Rabb in a record; my Rabb neither errs nor forgets (anything).” He is the One who made the earth a carpet for you; made in it many paths for you (to come and go); and sent down water (rain) from the sky.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسي بِآيتِنآ أَنْ أَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ مِنَ الظُّلُمتِ إِلَي النُّورِ لا وَذَكِّرْهُمْ بِأَيَّامِ اللهِ ؕ إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لأَيَاتٍ لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: We certainly sent Musa (as a Messenger) with Our signs, (commanding,) “Bring your people out of the darknesses into the light, and remind them of the days of Allah (the terrible events that took place by His command)!”; indeed in them are many sure signs for everyone who is patient and grateful.
